step3.ptxt: On this model, the hands-free function built into the navigation receiver assembly can be used by using a Bluetooth compatible cellular phone.
A Bluetooth cellular phone is used for hands-free calls.

item.ptxt: When replacing the navigation receiver assembly on a vehicle not subscribed to the G-BOOK service, perform the vehicle linking setting. (see )

When replacing the navigation receiver assembly on a vehicle subscribed to the G-BOOK service, perform the vehicle linking setting, then perform the G-BOOK use resumption operation and HELPNET service start operation. (see )
If the navigation receiver assembly is replaced while a purchased G-SOUND unlimited license exists, perform G-SOUND license recovery. (see )

step2.ptxt: Use a model whose operation has been verified for hands-free calls.
